tools.name: nextagency_get_profile
tools.description: The NextAgency user the token acts as: id, name, email and role. Use it to check the connection.

tools.name: nextagency_list_users
tools.description: The agency's users (brokers and staff): id, name, email, role. Use the id as assigned_to in nextagency_create_case_task.

tools.name: nextagency_list_cases
tools.description: The cases the token can see, one page at a time: id, case number, name, sales status, stage, owner, market segment. Filter by sales status (for example Prospect or Client) or by case number. Use the id with the other case tools.

tools.name: nextagency_search_cases
tools.description: Cases whose name, number or contact details match the query, one page at a time.

tools.name: nextagency_get_case
tools.description: One case by id: its details, status, stage, owner and addresses.

tools.name: nextagency_list_case_contacts
tools.description: The contacts linked to one case, with the primary flag. Use nextagency_get_contact for one contact.

tools.name: nextagency_list_case_employees
tools.description: The employees of one case (group business): name, employment type, start and termination dates, pay cycle.

tools.name: nextagency_list_case_custom_fields
tools.description: The custom fields of one case, with their names and values.

tools.name: nextagency_list_case_benefits
tools.description: The insurance benefits (policies) of one case: type, carrier and features.

tools.name: nextagency_list_case_tasks
tools.description: The tasks of one case: title, stage, type, priority, due date and assignees.

tools.name: nextagency_get_case_task
tools.description: One task of a case by id.

tools.name: nextagency_list_case_notes
tools.description: The notes of one case: title, body, pinned flag, author and assignees. Use nextagency_get_case_note for one note.

tools.name: nextagency_get_case_note
tools.description: One note of a case by id, with its full body.

tools.name: nextagency_list_contacts
tools.description: The agency's contacts, one page at a time: name, emails, phone numbers and addresses.

tools.name: nextagency_search_contacts
tools.description: Contacts whose name, email or details match the query, one page at a time.

tools.name: nextagency_find_contacts_by_phone
tools.description: The contacts that have this phone number. Enter the digits only, for example 5551234567.

tools.name: nextagency_get_contact
tools.description: One contact by id: name, emails, phone numbers and addresses.

tools.name: nextagency_list_carriers
tools.description: The insurance carriers in the agency's list: name, states and contact details.

tools.name: nextagency_list_sub_agents
tools.description: The sub-agents (vendors and individual agents) of the agency.

tools.name: nextagency_create_case
tools.description: WRITE: create a new case. Give a name, or a first name for an individual (market_segment individual). The API checks the whole request first: an invalid request stores nothing. Returns the new case.

tools.name: nextagency_create_case_note
tools.description: WRITE: add a note to one case. Use the title for a short label and the body for the text. Returns the new note.

tools.name: nextagency_create_case_task
tools.description: WRITE: add a task to one case. The due date uses the format of the vendor example: DD-MM-YYYY HH:MM AM UTC. assigned_to takes user ids from nextagency_list_users. Returns the new task.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: nextagency_get_profile, nextagency_list_users, nextagency_list_contacts, nextagency_search_contacts, nextagency_get_contact · Private data: nextagency_get_profile, nextagency_list_cases, nextagency_search_cases, nextagency_list_case_contacts, nextagency_list_contacts, nextagency_search_contacts, nextagency_find_contacts_by_phone, nextagency_get_contact, nextagency_list_carriers · Public sink: nextagency_get_profile, nextagency_list_users, nextagency_search_contacts · Destructive: nextagency_create_case_task.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: nextagency_get_profile, nextagency_list_users, nextagency_list_contacts, nextagency_search_contacts, nextagency_get_contact · Private data: nextagency_get_profile, nextagency_list_cases, nextagency_search_cases, nextagency_list_case_contacts, nextagency_list_contacts, nextagency_search_contacts, nextagency_find_contacts_by_phone, nextagency_get_contact, nextagency_list_carriers · Public sink: nextagency_get_profile, nextagency_list_users, nextagency_search_contacts · Destructive: nextagency_create_case_task

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
